stopped.title: This reading is for adults
stopped.body: Thank you for your interest. This service is only for people aged 18 and over, so we can't offer a reading. If something is weighing on you, a trusted adult, a school counsellor or a helpline can help: findahelpline.com lists free services for young people in many countries (in India, Tele-MANAS 14416; in the US, 988; in the UK, Childline 0800 1111).
